name: MedAgentsBench
intro: MedAgentsBench 对应论文最新版 MedicalAgentsBench，是一个从八个医学问答数据集按模型难度、人工推理深度、临床有效性和污染风险筛选出的复杂医疗推理基准，最终包含 862 道困难选择题。
org: Yale University, ETH Zurich, Stanford University
build_method: 难度感知筛选、临床阶段医学生审核、MELD污染筛查
task_type: 医疗推理, 多项选择问答, Agent方法比较
eval_feature: 低于50%正确率门槛, 五级推理深度, 成本Pareto分析
scale: 862道困难题，8个源数据集，9个评测子集
task_type_en: Medical reasoning, multiple-choice QA, agent-method comparison
build_method_en: Difficulty-aware filtering, clinical-year medical-student review, MELD contamination screening
eval_feature_en: Below-50% accuracy gate, five-level reasoning depth, cost Pareto analysis
intro_en: MedAgentsBench corresponds to the current MedicalAgentsBench paper: a complex medical reasoning benchmark filtered from eight medical QA datasets using model difficulty, human reasoning-depth and clinical-validity review, and contamination screening. The final set contains 862 hard multiple-choice questions.
scale_en: 862 hard questions, 8 source datasets, 9 evaluation subsets

drawio_review_note: Reviewed against arXiv:2503.07459v3 (revised 2026-06-16), official Git tag v1.0 commit e4f3f868a8ee6d5b4d4282701a7ba7b1d66e4da6, Hugging Face dataset revision 87e99bf48306788076dced215926e29c835fa892, and Zenodo dataset record 18944609 (2026-05-21 archive checksum md5:e3ecfb8e265f39b9fcc83fd3e2b3edf9), plus code-release record 18944554 (v1.0 archive checksum md5:4c5f721cb95142d1fdff5ab1a7c8956a). The canonical paper-v3 flow uses eight source datasets split into nine subsets; diverse-model probing with hard iff k/N < 50%; at most 100 per subset; four clinical-year medical students, a 10-example calibration, five-level minimum-step rubric, overlapping annotations and Fleiss kappa 0.62; group review on any flag and removal only with at least two agreements; 21 human-review exclusions (5 wrong answers, 5 poor context, 11 clinical irrelevance); and MELD option removal, half-question continuation and Levenshtein screening. The paper does not disclose the MELD cutoff, MELD exclusion count, or how exclusions reconcile with the stated per-subset counts; no replacement policy is published. Its released core count is 862 (seven subsets x 100, MedBullets 89, MMLU 73; mean 147.4 tokens). Evaluation uses seven base models and three internalized reasoning models plus nine externalized methods with nonuniform coverage (the paper applies SPO and AFlow only to GPT-4o-mini and GPT-4o), standardized prompts, hard-set agent results and three runs; the v1.0 scorer keeps the first row per realidx, uses answer_idx else answer, scores exact equality, and averages only emitted retained rows, so missing IDs are not restored and no fixed-862 denominator is enforced. Parsers are method-specific; no single universal parser is released. The v1.0 scorer's avg_time is the mean logged time_elapsed, and the paper defines wall-clock time per sample to include complete agent interaction cycles. However, pinned plots/figure1_pareto.ipynb divides DeepSeek-V3 average time by 10 before plotting; displayed time markers are therefore adjusted, while the accuracy-cost Pareto dominance calculation does not use time. Version drift is explicit: the Git v1.0 README and the Hugging Face and Zenodo releases add 32 AfriMedQA hard items, so the ten listed evaluation task subsets total 894 rows, while the paper's core Methods, Figure 6 and Table 4 retain nine subsets and 862 rows; its Figure 1 caption mentions AfriMedQA, and no reconciliation is published. Formal publication evidence [site-a11s-paper-alignment]: normalized Draw.io and architecture sidecars plus native fixed-light SVG/PNG pairs were regenerated from the checked-in bilingual specs. Final PNG dimensions are 1847×1321 (English) and 1847×1321 (Chinese); SVG viewBoxes are 1845×1319 and 1845×1319. The final exports were inspected without clipping, node overlap, connector-node crossing, fallback text, or adaptive colors.
